anomalies.description: The man is attacked by a third party while in a vulnerable position (engaged with the woman), resulting in him being overpowered and thrown to the ground, indicating an assault on a helpless victim during an intimate moment.
A third person (dark-skinned man) violently grabs the man from behind, lifting and throwing him; the man is seen screaming and being subdued on the floor in a physical struggle.
A man in dark clothing violently attacks another man, grabbing him from behind, lifting him, and slamming him down; the victim is visibly struggling and in distress throughout the sequence.

The attacker continues to hold the victim in a chokehold or headlock while the victim appears incapacitated and helpless; a third person (blonde woman) is also restrained in the background, indicating coordinated subjugation.
